name: High Performance Motor Oil Conditioner

features.text: specially formulated to reduce friction and wear.
protects new engines during break-in and start up.
contains dispersants and detergents to help prevent sludge deposits.
can be used in all types of internal-combustion engines.
designed for use in conventional and synthetic oils.
Contains no solvents or chlorinated materials.

description: Scientifically formulated to increase performance by reducing, friction and wear. MOC® High Performance Motor Oil Conditioner contains dispersants and detergents to help prevent sludge buildup. The product is carried by motor oil to where it lubricates internal parts to create a low-friction surface. This reduction in friction can protect new engines during break-in, and start-ups. It may be used in all internal-combustion engines, including rotary and diesel.
application: Pour entire contents into crankcase with each oil change.

ad.headline: High Performance
ad.description: Enhances engine oil’s ability to reduce friction and wear on internal engine components. Advanced antioxidants prevent oxidation and thickening of engine oil under even the most severe driving conditions. Special dispersants help keep piston ring belts, hydraulic lifters and other engine components clean and free of sludge or deposits. It is compatible with both synthetic and petroleum based oils.
benefits: Greatly improves engine oil’s ability to resist oxidation breakdown.
Protects vital engine parts during start-ups.
Compatible with both synthetic and regular oil.
